about: s23: Sunita's reply, numbers lift out as digits. Cue times are seconds from the shot's start. words: when each word of L17 is said (L17 at 0.9; onsets read off L17.wav), so each cuts in on it; four, two: चार and दो cut to their digits, on the beat or half beat after they're said; chip: the app's 'Counts pakke' chip. 'island' lines: text (app copy), optional sub, kind plain|shimmer, in type|cut, or hide.
